name: independent-evidence-agent-to-translator
hypothesis: A clean-context translation agent will use corpus evidence more reliably when a separate evidence-only agent first produces a persistent, cited report instead of carrying its own exploratory reasoning into generation.
activation_condition: Use an independent evidence-only Luna session for every assigned language, then start a fresh Luna translation session whose only inter-agent bridge is .runner/report.md.
fallback: When the report is inconclusive, preserve the strongest coherent construction directly attested by the supplied exact examples; never invent a distinction merely to resolve uncertainty.
falsifier: The topology is falsified if it does not improve paired translation quality over the same-agent staged harness, if report claims lack inspectable citations, or if the fresh translator ignores or degrades directly attested project conventions.
agent_instructions: This experiment has two strictly separated roles. The first Luna agent is an evidence researcher only: it must not draft or recommend a complete translation. It writes .runner/report.md using only the supplied project, with citations to the exact example or corpus-row identifiers that support each claim. The second Luna agent starts with fresh context, reads that report and the cited underlying project evidence, and translates. Treat every observable convention in the supplied target examples as binding. Keep directly attested evidence separate from inference.
research_prompt: Act only as the evidence agent. Research all three assigned source verses using the exact examples, immediate passage context, semantically related source rows, and target-side concordances available inside this project. Write .runner/report.md with one section per task containing: (1) every source proposition, participant and semantic role, relation, polarity, quantity, and name that must survive; (2) directly attested target wording and constructions with precise supplied row/example citations; (3) inferences in a visibly separate subsection; (4) conflicts, ambiguity, and unsupported gaps; and (5) concise constraints for a later translator. Do not draft, paraphrase, or recommend any complete target translation. The report is the only communication channel to a separate translation agent. End only after the cited report exists.
translation_prompt: You are a new, independent translation agent; you did not perform the research phase. Read .runner/report.md first, then inspect every cited underlying example or corpus row needed to verify it. Translate all three assigned verses. Prefer coherent, repeated, directly attested project constructions; never splice incompatible fragments. Follow every observable convention demonstrated by the target examples rather than defaults associated with the language label. Before answering, check that no source proposition, participant, semantic role, relation, polarity, quantity, or name was omitted or added. Return only the controller-required structured JSON.
